thesis: Taiwan is currently more attractive as a finished-product/bench-industrial market while Mainland China is more attractive as a donor/substrate market. Commodity protocol converters are too cheap in China to justify simple clone arbitrage.

finished_product_anchors.name: generic China-origin Android industrial touch panel listed in Taiwan

candidate_routes.transformation: retain display, touch, compute, stand/enclosure and PSU; add HS low-voltage isolated I/O sidecar plus a reproducible Linux/test-console image
candidate_routes.market_fit: lab/shopfloor test console; explicitly not certified industrial HMI

candidate_routes.transformation: retain compute/enclosure/networking; add isolated RS-485/CAN/digital I/O sidecar, target-power protection and HS evidence agent
candidate_routes.illustrative_margin_note: roughly 30-60% depending donor lot and sidecar; requires richer workflow value than commodity Modbus gateways

candidate_routes.transformation: retain industrial enclosure/serial/network/power architecture; refurbish storage and add bounded HS software/optional I/O adapter

candidate_routes.donor: NEC J1900 15-inch touch POS exact-model lots
candidate_routes.transformation: retain touch/display/compute/enclosure/interfaces; add compact isolated I/O sidecar and preconfigured instrumentation/test workflow

candidate_routes.donor: HP T620 / Dell N03D exact approved models
candidate_routes.transformation: retain low-power x86 platform; add HS sidecar only where the finished workflow cannot be bought as a RMB 50-235 commodity module
use PCIe/storage expandability for a higher-performance multi-instrument/DAQ/NAS edge node rather than a simple gateway

avoid: component harvesting where intact module reuse is available

cross_border_boundary.taiwan_note: Do not treat Mainland China e-waste/scrap as ordinary import inventory. Taiwan waste import/export rules require permits for regulated waste. Cross-border sourcing should use clearly functional used equipment with documentation and category-specific customs/environment review.

claim_boundary: All candidate COGS and target prices are screening assumptions, not quotes, measured yield, demand evidence, certification equivalence, or sale authorization.
